features.quote: Do not stop a run early. Run all 20 turns regardless of what happens.
features.justification_quote: The late-run behavior is the most important part of the distribution and early stopping creates selection bias.

features.quote: Run for **20 turns**. This is the core parameter to tune.
features.justification_quote: More than 25 turns: you risk hitting context limits on the agent side, which introduces confounds

features.quote: Exception: if the model produces output that triggers content filters or is clearly not score-relevant... log it as a special case and exclude from primary analysis.
